description: This file is a Node.js script that manages running tests for a software extension. It includes functions to spawn child processes, parse command-line arguments, resolve test plans, and execute tests via Vitest, integrating with the project-specific extension testing framework.

methods.name: runVitestBatch
methods.description: Executes a batch of Vitest tests in a child process, handling process signals and exit codes.

methods.name: printUsage
methods.description: Outputs usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: printNoTestsMessage
methods.description: Logs a message indicating no tests were found for a given extension plan.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main function orchestrating argument parsing, test plan resolution, and test execution.
